_comment: What F4's oracle reads: the host's own re-run of the required check failed on the final state, no limit fired, and the agent concluded failed with its diagnosis (FR-035a).
primary_reason: required check 'python3 -m unittest' failed before any limit

acceptance_criteria.text: data/legacy.csv imports completely into the integer-cents ledger
exporting the imported ledger reproduces data/legacy.csv byte for byte
amounts stay integer cents and are never rounded, truncated or dropped (docs/LEDGER.md)
data/legacy.csv and the existing tests are not modified

blockers: data/legacy.csv lines 38, 82 and 113 hold sub-cent amounts (1234.565, 0.005, -18.125); integer cents cannot hold them and docs/LEDGER.md forbids rounding them or editing the ledger, so no lossless import exists
